items.source: Return all reachable types as List of classes. The resulting list is unmodifiable.
items.translation: 返回所有可达类型作为 classes 的列表。生成的列表是不可修改的。

items.source: Container for reachable types starting from a set of root types.
items.translation: 从一组根类型开始的可到达类型的容器。

items.source:
Performs the given action for each element of the reachable types until all elements have been processed or the
action throws an exception.
items.translation: 对每个可达类型的元素执行给定操作，直到所有元素都被处理或操作抛出异常。

items.source:
Performs the given action for each element of the reachable types until all elements have been processed or the
action throws an exception. Actions are performed in the order of iteration, if that order is specified.
Exceptions thrown by the action are relayed to the caller.
items.translation: 对可达类型的每个元素执行给定操作，直到所有元素都被处理或操作抛出异常。如果指定了迭代顺序，则按该顺序执行操作。操作抛出的异常将传递给调用者。

items.source: action - The action to be performed for each element
items.translation: action - 对每个元素执行的操作

items.source: Christoph Strobl, Sebastien Deleuze, John Blum, Mark Paluch
an unmodifiable list of reachable types.
items.translation: 一个不可修改的可到达类型列表。
